claim_boundary: Selected-submatrix implementation-boundary evidence for the matched Ridge/Tikhonov filter; no quantum speedup, numerical superiority, full IEEE-scale execution, scalable residual loading, full sparse block encoding, or nonlinear-loop QSVT.
negative_boundary_statement: For the tested raw and explicitly condition-controlled IEEE-derived selected blocks with kappa >= 1e2 and lambda <= 1e-2, no row was both accurate and phase-synthesizable within the tested polynomial and phase-synthesis limits.
